coverage.finding: The top-left page label reads '198' followed by a raised 'b' and a point. The candidate's '198b.' matches it.

The single line 'Do., ⟦#⟧ Do, ff.101-202, pon ⟦…⟧ vii.2 [to/&] end.' is confirmed in tile 0,0. The struck character before the second 'Do' and the struck short word before 'vii.2' are visible. A hooked line at about x 3030–3330, y about 1245 crosses the gutter toward the 'c' on the facing page. The uncertainties are appropriately kept.

Both lines are confirmed. The first connector after 'only' is a cursive ampersand-like sign. The sign between 'v' and 'x-xii' looks more like '+', and the candidate notes this. The struck word before 'scribe' is visible. A hook and a horizontal line run into the gutter at y about 2530. The final parenthesis and the macron on the parenthetical name are not secure.

Two cramped lines are confirmed. The numeral after 'adhy. x' is overwritten. The bracketed addition after '628' is written with a slash or bracket-like stroke and '+.627)'. A hook stands at about x 3100, and a left-pointing arrow on the facing page sits at y about 2775. The second line ends 'Kāśī S.1610'.
'For complete MSS. cf. Eggeling 2174-2179' is confirmed. An arrow on the facing page at y about 4130 lies at the level of the c. 421 row on fol. 199.
The line is confirmed as written, with 'imp.' unexpanded. An arrow on the facing page sits at y about 4475.

unresolved.issue: In the parenthetical name, the first 'a' of 'Kayastha' may carry a macron or breve. The word ending and the closing mark may be 'th)' or 'th/'. The candidate's 'Kayastha)' may therefore normalize the written form.
unresolved.next_check: Inspect at higher magnification around x 2400–2900, y 2620–2690.

unresolved.issue: Two readings are unresolved. The overwritten numeral may be 'xi' or 'x', or the overwrite may change 'xi' to 'x'. The bracket structure '(ff. 575-628 [/ or (]+.627)' is unclear.

The arrow at y about 4475 lies between the b. 46 (1) and b. 46 (3) rows on fol. 199, probably nearer b. 46 (3). That row has struck text 'adh. 2 & pt. of 3', which the note could replace. This is inferred only from position and content.
unresolved.next_check: Compare the native-resolution y positions on fol. 199 for b. 46 (1) and b. 46 (3).

unresolved.issue: The arrow's level matches the c. 421 row more closely than d. 530 (4). The parent remains uncertain.
unresolved.next_check: Check fol. 199 at native resolution for the arrow's target row.

These are facing-page material and are correctly excluded as records, apart from noting the arrows' linkage. All attachments to fol. 199 parents remain probable or uncertain, as the candidate states.

region_review.bottom: Holds b005 and b006, an ink dot at about (405, 4285) and several stray specks. The ruled area below b006 is blank on review.
region_review.right_margin: There is no text at the gutter side. The line and hook ends of b002, b003 and b004 cross into the facing page, and arrows sit on the facing page.
